navigation.timeOperationsDescription: Attendance, shifts, approvals, and payroll-ready records will live here.

auth.shellDescription: Role-based access for Taams administrators and staff.
auth.signInDescription: Sign in to manage workforce operations, time and attendance, approvals, and payroll-ready data from one administrative workspace.
auth.signInFooter: Access is created and managed by your Taams administrator.
auth.signInPanelDescription: Bring HR records and attendance activity together, with clean data ready for payroll integration.
auth.signInSuccessMessage: You have been logged in successfully.
auth.loginFailed: Sign in failed. Please try again.
auth.forgotPasswordDescription: Enter your email to request a reset code. SMS delivery will be connected later.
auth.forgotPasswordSuccessHelp: Use the verification code from SMS or your administrator. During setup, use 111111.
auth.requestResetFailed: Failed to start password reset. Please try again.
auth.requestResetSuccessMessage: Use verification code 111111 to set your password.
auth.resetPasswordDescription: Enter your email, verification code, and a new password.
auth.resetPasswordSuccessMessage: Your password has been updated. You can now sign in.
auth.resetPasswordFailed: Failed to reset password. Please try again.
auth.emailAndOtpRequired: Email and verification code are required.
auth.signupDisabledDescription: A Taams administrator creates your user account. Use password setup after your account is created.
auth.signupDisabledHelp: Contact your administrator if you need access to Taams.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.emptyDescription: Start by adding employees. Attendance capture, schedules, approvals, and reporting will build from this workspace.

core.workSchedulesAndShiftsDescription: Manage reusable shifts, breaks, work schedules, and weekly schedule days.
core.shiftsDescription: Define attendance windows and timing rules.
core.shiftFormDescription: Set the shift name, grace rules, and active state. Add working time windows as segments.
core.noShiftsDescription: Create shifts before building work schedule days.
core.selectShiftForBreaks: Select a shift to manage its breaks.
core.selectShiftForSegments: Select a shift to manage its work segments.
core.shiftSegmentFormDescription: Set the named work window for this shift, such as Morning Session.
core.noShiftSegmentsDescription: Add work windows such as Morning Session or Afternoon Session for this shift.
core.shiftBreakFormDescription: Set the break window and whether it is paid.
core.noShiftBreaksDescription: Add breaks such as lunch or tea time for this shift.
core.workSchedulesDescription: Create weekly schedule templates for employees.
core.workScheduleFormDescription: Keep schedule names and default status clear for assignment.
core.noWorkSchedulesDescription: Create a schedule, then add its weekly days.
core.workScheduleDayFormDescription: Choose the weekday and assign a shift or mark it as an off day.
core.noWorkScheduleDaysDescription: Add days to define the weekly pattern.
core.selectWorkScheduleForDays: Select a work schedule to manage its days.
core.organizationStructureDescription: Manage departments as a simple reporting tree.
core.departmentTreeDescription: Select a department to browse its child departments.
core.departmentDetailsDescription: Keep names, codes, and active state aligned with the organization.
core.childDepartmentsDescription: Browse the direct departments under the selected department.
core.noChildDepartmentsDescription: Add a child department to continue building this branch of the organization.
core.departmentFormDescription: Use the English name as the required display name. Amharic and code are optional.
core.positionsDescription: Define job titles that can be assigned to employees.
core.positionFormDescription: Create reusable positions for employee assignment.
core.employeesDescription: Manage employee records, organization assignment, and reporting relationships.
core.employeeDirectoryDescription: Browse employees and open records for supervisor setup.
core.employeeFormDescription: Fill the employee profile and optionally create a login user.
core.departmentEmployeeCounts: Select a department to view and add employees.
core.selectDepartmentFirst: Select a department before adding an employee.
core.employeeCreateAfterUserFailed: The login user was created, but the employee record failed. You can retry employee creation and link the existing user later.
core.employeeProfileDescription: Personal and contact information for this employee.
core.supervisorsDescription: Reporting relationships assigned to this employee.
core.assignSupervisorDescription: Choose another employee as supervisor and set the effective period.
core.createLoginUserDescription: Creates an admin-managed account. The employee sets their first password with reset-password.
core.noDepartmentsDescription: Create departments to start building the organization structure and assigning employees.
core.noPositionsDescription: Create reusable positions so employee records can carry consistent job assignments.
core.noEmployeesDescription: Add employees to build the workforce directory for attendance, approvals, and payroll-ready records.
core.saveFailed: Unable to save changes. Please try again.

rbac.usersDescription: Manage employees and their system access from one operational workspace.
rbac.rolesDescription: Create access roles and decide which permissions each role receives.
rbac.permissionsDescription: Define the system capabilities that can be assigned to roles.
rbac.createRoleDescription: Use short system names such as attendance_manager or payroll_admin.
rbac.updateRoleDescription: Adjust the role name or description without changing its assigned permissions.
rbac.roleDescriptionPlaceholder: Can review attendance and manage schedules
rbac.rolesListDescription: Select a role to adjust its permissions.
rbac.assignPermissionsDescription: Choose the exact capabilities this role should grant.
rbac.selectRoleEmpty: Create or select a role to manage permissions.
rbac.createPermissionDescription: Name capabilities by resource and action so they are easy to audit.
rbac.updatePermissionDescription: Adjust the permission name, resource, action, or description.
rbac.permissionsCatalogDescription: Reusable capabilities available for role assignment.
rbac.saveFailed: Unable to save changes. Please try again.
